comments.comment: I can’t believe I’ve never watched this before! It’s so cool to hear what bob says, because it confirms so many things my family have told me before. So my aunt actually used to be one of the flight attendants for Area 51 for over 40+ years(now retired), she would fly people in daily. Once they land in Area 51 she had to stay there all day until the team was ready to go. She said that they had a full gym, lounge area to watch soap opera’s to stay busy for the attendants. As far as bob talking about the ship (32:45) and it being cold to the touch and the material it was made of, my grandpa was a space x engineer and was sent to Area 51 for a test on a material around the 1950’s-1960’s. They did all there standard testing that they would do for space crafts on this thin sheet of metal he said was as thin as tin foil. They froze it, heated up as high as they could and said it was completely cold to the touch. They also took a sledge hammer and tried making a dent in it and it didn’t do a thing! I’m just blown away. I think this is so cool and I’m glad this video continues to surface and bob gets his recognition!
